query: INSERT INTO nhcx_participants (tenant_id, participant_code, participant_name, role, entity_type, source, synced_at) SELECT DISTINCT ON (code) $1, code, name, role, entity, 'registry', now() FROM unnest($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::text[]) AS r(code, name, role, entity) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, participant_code) DO UPDATE SET participant_name = EXCLUDED.participant_name, role = EXCLUDED.role, entity_type = EXCLUDED.entity_type, source = 'registry', synced_at = now(), is_active = true, updated_at = now()
